subject: POC: prompt dataset & evaluation plan - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmecorp.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmecorp.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-01T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: POC: prompt dataset & evaluation plan - next steps

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for your time today - great conversation and excited about the potential fit. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the agreed next steps so we can align on timelines and ownership for the POC focused on improving internal knowledge-base assisted responses.

Recap / Success criteria (we discussed):
- Improve answer relevance for KB-driven queries by >=15% (measured via NDCG on your labeled query set)
- Reduce hallucination rate on KB lookups by 50% (per your internal error typology)
- Achieve median end-to-end latency < 400ms for typical 512-token prompts during peak load

Customer actions (what we need from you):
1) Share a representative prompt set (50-200 prompts) and 200-500 anonymized historical logs for eval (logs should include input prompt, KB doc id references, and accepted answer). Preferred formats: CSV/JSONL.
2) Provide your prioritized success criteria and any hard constraints (SLA, redaction rules, PII handling).
3) Assign a single POC owner on your side for day-to-day coordination.

Our actions:
- Aditya will design an initial eval plan and run a first-pass quality baseline within 3 business days of receiving the dataset.
- We'll spin up a short-lived Dedicated instance for the trial and provide a shared evaluation dashboard.
- We will not store raw logs beyond the POC retention window unless you opt-in; we'll provide a scrubbed results export.

Proposed timelines:
- Dataset delivery from AcmeCorp by 2026-11-04
- Redwood first-pass eval and baseline by 2026-11-07
- Joint review + success criteria sign-off by 2026-11-09

Attachments: example template attached for prompts/logs (acme_prompt_template.csv).

Please reply with the dataset or let me know if the timeline is tight and we should shift by a week. If you prefer, we can set up a 30-min session to walk through data export.

Thanks - looking forward to getting started.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

---
Attachment: acme_prompt_template.csv (CSV stub: columns: prompt_id,prompt_text,context_doc_id,expected_answer,priority)

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC: prompt dataset & evaluation plan - next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap. We're aligned - I've pulled together an initial prompt set and sample logs. Attaching two files: acme_prompt_set_v1.csv and acme_kb_sample.jsonl. Note that the logs include redacted PII, and we've removed any customer-identifying fields per our policy.

Quick notes:
- The 200 logs are a mix of support and in-product queries; some are multi-turn but we've flattened to single-turn sequences here.
- Our primary metric is relevance judged by a 3-point scale (incorrect, partially correct, correct) rather than NDCG; happy to map to NDCG if you prefer.
- Can you confirm you will only use these artifacts for the POC and that raw logs won't be persisted beyond the trial retention window?

Owner for POC on our side: Sarah Jenkins (cc'd).

Tom
Tom Nguyen
Data Science Manager, AcmeCorp
tom.nguyen@acmecorp.com

Attachments: acme_prompt_set_v1.csv, acme_kb_sample.jsonl

From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-02T11:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC: prompt dataset & evaluation plan - next steps

Marissa - thanks for the heads up and thanks Tom for the files.

I'll take point on the eval plan as discussed. Next steps on our side:
- Ingest the CSV/JSONL into our eval harness (we'll doc any schema mapping we do).
- Run baseline evaluations on the candidate open models we discussed + a Redwood-optimized variant.
- Produce a short dashboard capturing: relevance distribution, hallucination cases (with examples), latency distribution under 1/5/10 concurrent users, and suggested prompt engineering/quantization knobs.

Timeline: with the dataset received this morning, I can have the baseline report and dashboard ready by 2026-11-07 EOD PST.

Questions for Acme:
1) For the 3-point judgment scale, can you share the mapping you want for NDCG (we can map offline)?
2) Any doc-level access controls we should be aware of for the KB samples (e.g., some docs are internal only)?

I'll also prepare a short playbook describing how we'll handle redaction and retention; Marissa, can you confirm the retention window we should propose in the contract (7 days/30 days)?

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Applied ML / Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: POC: prompt dataset & evaluation plan - next steps

Thanks Tom - and thanks Aditya. Quick confirmations and next steps so nothing drifts: 

1) Retention window: we will propose a 14-day POC data retention window by default (we'll scrub and export aggregated results at the end). If Acme needs shorter, we can revise.
2) Evaluation mapping: Aditya will map your 3-point score to NDCG and include both raw judgments + NDCG in the report.
3) Ownership and coordination: Sarah (Acme) is the POC owner; Aditya is Redwood's technical owner; I'll coordinate timelines and procurement touchpoints.
4) Logistics: I'll create a shared folder (link below) for results and schedule a 30-min check-in on 2026-11-09 to review the baseline. 

Immediate asks for Acme for us to start:
- Confirm retention window is OK (reply-all)
- If you have a preferred way to share the full logs (S3 presigned link, Drive, or secure upload), confirm and we will use that.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-poc
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2345

If no red flags, we'll move forward with the 14-day window and Aditya will begin ingest tomorrow.
